verdict.rationale: Factory's docs describe operating it by delegating tasks in plain language from the App or terminal. In the Droid CLI, AI interpretation is the default, and `!` toggles bash mode to bypass it. You can also tell Design mode what to change, @mention Factory in Linear/Jira comments to start work, and define Missions conversationally with Droid. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and an explicit first-party description of the natural-language prompt interface (it is mostly implied through delegation wording).
